approved_payload.title: Flora Park, Polokwane (approx.): man stabbed to death in a park opposite a vote-counting station, 5 Nov
approved_payload.content: A 31-year-old man was stabbed to death in a park opposite Flora Park Comprehensive School in Polokwane on Thursday 5 November, IOL reported, citing police. SABC News said votes from the municipal elections were being counted at the school. Police said an earlier altercation between two people said to belong to the same political party had been resolved, but the suspect allegedly returned, stabbed the man in the neck and fled; he was declared dead at the scene and a knife was recovered. Police arrested a 35-year-old man, who was expected to appear in the Polokwane Magistrate's Court on a charge of murder. Police did not name the party and said the motive was not yet known. The EFF's provincial chairperson told SABC News the dead man was the party's treasurer at its Flora Park branch. No one is named here. Police statements carried by news outlets; no SAPS statement found. The map point is approximate: two schools in Polokwane are called Flora Park Comprehensive (a primary and a high school) and the reports do not say which, so the pin is between them in Flora Park, not the park itself.
